networks.comment: Control-plane network for the dockside container itself. dockside_mac is set for ING-chain defense-in-depth (blocks lateral connections to dockside) even though no devtainer attaches here in this example. dockside_egress stays "exempt": dockside's own required egress on this network hasn't been inventoried yet, so there's no rule set to switch to "policed" against.
networks.name: dockside

networks.comment: Private/sensitive workspaces: internet access but blocked from the LAN.
networks.name: ds-priv

networks.comment: Clone/staging workspaces: like prod but with a DNAT redirect to the test database.
networks.name: ds-clone

networks.comment: Production workspaces: full outbound internet access, restricted lateral movement.
networks.name: ds-prod
